Messages.Author: Estfinel
Messages.Body:
How does this work together with the new errata?

Player X playes Hostile Takeover, and wins the bid on Player Y's
vampire. Player Y plays banishment on the same said vampire. The
vampire then returns to Player Y's uncontrolled region (per the new
errata).

Q. If that vampire comes back into play, does it "remember" the
Hostile Takeover and go back into Player X's controlled region or does
it just go into Player Y's controlled region?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Estfinel wrote:
>
> How does this work together with the new errata?

What new errata?
The latest on Banishment is a ruling from May 2000.

> Player X playes Hostile Takeover, and wins the bid on Player Y's
> vampire. Player Y plays banishment on the same said vampire. The
> vampire then returns to Player Y's uncontrolled region (per the new
> errata).

He is placed in X's uncontrolled region, per the [RTR 01-MAY-2000] ruling.

> Q. If that vampire comes back into play, does it "remember" the
> Hostile Takeover and go back into Player X's controlled region or does
> it just go into Player Y's controlled region?

If X influences him out, he comes out in X's ready region.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <f7b815b1.01110...@posting.google.com>, Estfinel
<wood...@picerneri.com> writes:
[Hostile Takeover and Banishment]

>How does this work together with the new errata?

I believe you are reading:

">>>>TEMPORARY<<<< control effects are ended if the vampire is Banished,
as normal, so the vampire would be placed in his previous (permanent)
controller's uncontrolled region. [RTR 20000501] " (Emphasis mine.)

Hostile Takeover is not a temporary control effect.

Malkavian Dementia, Mind Rape et al, are.
